events.prompt: Paint the area I painted red.
events.transcript_tail:
Choose what to do, type a request, and press Send. The reply is shown here; nothing is saved until you press Save to note.
You
Paint the area I painted red.
MODEL PROPOSAL · REGION EDIT
“Paint the selected region red (no ground moved).”
1. Paint the region red (colour blend, 80% opacity)   (ramp shape not given, the default is used)
    “Colour the painted region red as requested.”  (model's words)
Preview (worked out by the app on a copy of the region; nothing has changed):
Colour: red, colour blend, 80% opacity over the region. 2902 land cells in 1 piece change colour; water inside it keeps its colour, and nothing outside the region is touched.
Before
After
The colour pictures show the blend on a grey height shading (the real map's lighting and any paint already there are not drawn); cells outside the region are dimmed.
Applying adds the colour as a colour-paint layer mark inside this region only. It is one undo step (Edit ▸ Undo). It does not regenerate, erode or change settings.
[Dismiss]
[Apply 1 edit]
